title: PostgreSQL advisory locks are underrated. Solved a double-spend race condition in Reboxed's escrow release by combining them with serializable isolation. 12ms latency cost for financial correctness — always worth it.
GGUF vs GPTQ for local inference: GGUF wins on CPU, GPTQ wins on GPU. If you have <8GB VRAM, use GGUF Q4_K_M. Above 12GB, GPTQ 4-bit with ExLlama is 2x faster. Tested on Mistral-7B.

Stop using exponential backoff without jitter. Every reconnection storm I've debugged traces back to correlated retry timing. Add ±40% random jitter. It costs one line of code and saves hours of debugging.
